Version.description: API version requested by the consumer (SOL 013 9.4).
Version.name: Version

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.AffinityGroup.description: Producer-managed group of resources placed with affinity or anti-affinity.

groupId.description: Identifier of the group: a UUID, the Kubernetes UID of the object behind it.

groupName.description: Name of the group, given by the consumer.

scope.description: Scope of the group; NFVI node when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.AffinityOrAnti.description: Affinity or anti-affinity of a resource being allocated with other resources. Only one of affinityOrAntiAffinityResourceList, affinityOrAntiAffinityResourceGroupId may be set.

affinityOrAntiAffinityResourceGroupId.description: Identifier of an affinity group created with CreateAffinityGroup.

scope.description: Scope of the constraint; NFVI node when unset.

nextpage_opaque_marker.description: Marker of the next page; empty on the last page (SOL 013 5.4).

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.OperationalSta.description: Operational state of a virtualised resource (IFA006).

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.TypeOfStorage.description:
Type of a virtualised storage resource.
Values may be added as Kubernetes storage support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.VirtualStorage.description: Size, type and capabilities of a virtualised storage resource.

isBoot.description: The software image is copied to this storage and the compute resource boots from it.

sizeOfStorage.description: Size of the storage resource, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "20Gi").

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.Volume.description: A virtualised storage resource, e.g. a disk of a compute resource.

computeId.description: Compute resource that uses the volume; empty when not attached.

hostId.description: Host of the volume; empty for distributed storage.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

storageData.description: Size, type and capabilities of the volume.

volumeId.description:
Identifier of the volume: a UUID assigned by the VIM. Ephemeral disks of a compute
resource are not resources of their own and use their disk name instead.

volumeName.description: Name of the volume, given by the consumer; not unique.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.CertificateDa.description: Certificate material for a VNF in delegation mode (IFA006 8.4.11).

certificateFile.description: Signed certificate with the public key and chain.

keystoreFile.description: Keystore with key, certificate and chain, e.g. PKCS#12.

privateKey.description: Private key paired with the signed public key; with certificate_file, or keystore_file alone.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.Compute.description: A virtualised compute resource: a virtual machine.

accelerationCapability.description: Acceleration capabilities in use, as Kubernetes device resource names.

computeId.description: Identifier of the compute resource: a UUID, the Kubernetes UID of the object behind it.

computeName.description:
Name of the compute resource, given by the consumer. The VIM normalises it to a DNS label
and defaults it to the image name followed by "-vm".

flavourId.description: Flavour the compute resource is sized by.

hostId.description: Host the compute resource runs on (the Kubernetes node).

metadata.description: Metadata owned by the consumer and never interpreted by the VIM.

operationalState.description: Administrative state of the compute resource.

runningState.description: Running state of the compute resource.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable reason when the running state is FAILED.

vcImageId.description: Software image the compute resource boots from; empty for an empty container.

vimMetadata.description: Auxiliary information from the VIM, e.g. KubeVirt status; keys are listed in the metadata key registry.

virtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of the compute resource.

virtualDisks.description: Volumes attached to the compute resource, including its boot disk.

virtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of the compute resource.

virtualNetworkInterface.description: Network interfaces of the compute resource.

zoneId.description: Resource zone of the compute resource.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeOperat.description:
Operation on a compute resource (IFA006 7.3.1.6).
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeRunnin.description:
Running state of a compute resource.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add or replace.

networkInterfaceIdsToRemove.description: Network interfaces to remove, by resource_id (the interface name).

networkInterfacesToUpdate.description: Interfaces to change in place, e.g. re-attach to another port.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.IpAssignment.description: How a network interface gets its addresses.

nextpage_opaque_marker.description: Marker of the next page; empty on the last page (SOL 013 5.4).

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.NetworkInterf.description: A network interface requested for a new compute resource.

accelerationCapability.description: Acceleration capabilities, as Kubernetes device resource names.

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth limit in Mbps; 0 means no limit.

ipAssignment.description: How the interface gets its addresses.

macAddress.description: MAC address; the VIM assigns one when unset.

metadata.description: Metadata owned by the consumer and never interpreted by the VIM.

networkId.description: Network to attach to; one of network_id, subnet_id and network_port_id is required.

subnetId.description: Subnet to take addresses from; identifies the network on its own when network_id is unset.

typeConfiguration.description: Extra configuration for the interface type.

typeVirtualNic.description: How the interface is realised; the VIM chooses from the network when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.TypeVirtualNi.description:
How a network interface is realised.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.UserData.description: User data passed to the compute resource at boot time.

content.description: User data, e.g. a cloud-init document; transparent to the VIM.

method.description: How the content reaches the guest; NoCloud when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.UserDataTrans.description:
How user data reaches the guest.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of a compute resource.

cpuClock.description: Minimum CPU clock rate in MHz; 0 when not guaranteed.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualCpuPin.description: CPU pinning of a compute resource.

cpuMap.description: Physical CPU each virtual CPU is pinned to.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of a compute resource.

hugepageSize.description: Hugepage size backing the memory; empty for regular pages.

virtualMemSize.description: Amount of memory, in Kubernetes quantity format.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualNetwor.description: A network interface of a compute resource.

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth in Mbps; 0 when not limited.

hostPciAddress.description: PCI address of the device on the host, for SR-IOV and passthrough interfaces.

ipAddress.description: Addresses of the interface; may be empty until DHCP or the guest configures them.

isManagement.description: The management interface every compute resource gets on the pod network.

operationalState.description: ENABLED once the interface is attached and ready.

ownerId.description: Compute resource the interface belongs to.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the interface: its name, unique within the compute resource (e.g. "net1").

subnetId.description: Subnet the interface takes its addresses from.

vimMetadata.description: Auxiliary information from the VIM; keys are listed in the metadata key registry.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (SOL 013 8.3). The token URL is deployment specific.
